description: One line at session start pointing statistical work to the econometrics skill, for listings so crowded that Claude Code shows the skill by name only.

hooks.command: echo 'Note from the econometrics plugin: statistical work (hypothesis tests, confidence intervals, sample size, regression, the effect of a promotion or policy, forecasts from statistical models, VaR or ES) goes to the skill econometrics:econometrics. Load it before answering, even if the skill list shows only its name. Ignore this note for anything else, such as budgets, valuations or legal risk.'
